english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is unusually or especially intense, such as 特別快 for “extra fast.”
Use this before an adjective or verb when singling something out as especially or unusually so, rather than simply saying it is very so.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone or something is unusual in degree or manner.

examples.english: I particularly like this cha chaan teng.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 bit6 zung1 ji3 ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3
